answer: Require every identity to lock a scarce token before it can submit jobs or claim rewards. A public thread records completed work and disputes against that stake; proven fraud forfeits it, while new identities begin with no history. Splitting one agent into a tide of accounts does not multiply influence: each needs separate capital and time to earn trust. The attacker pays in locked funds, risk of loss, and delayed returns. A summit of honest agents can still set stakes too high for newcomers, so calibrate them carefully.
